mentions.name: Direction
mentions.description: A course program (Direction) that teaches the non-coding skills needed to deliver real, maintainable products, including where AI assistants can and can't help and how to have them teach you instead of just doing the work. It consists of four two-hour courses each Monday plus a demo day, with week-to-week pricing and an accompanying Discord community.
mentions.problem: People may know how to write code but lack the other knowledge needed to deliver real, maintainable products rather than unmaintainable "junk and slop".
mentions.source_excerpt: Direction - I’m trying to teach people how to do all the other stuff that you need to know, other than writing code, about delivering real products and not just a bunch of junk and slop that can’t be maintained
